data.speakerBio: 刘愿,北京大学经济学博士,华南师范大学经济与管理学院教授、博士生导师,华南市场经济研究中心(省级文科重点研究基地)副主任。研究兴趣集中在政治经济学、中国经济、经济史等领域。主持国家社会科学基金重点项目、国家自然科学基金面上项目、国家社会科学基金青年项目、教育部人文社会科学研究青年项目等纵向课题4项。在《管理世界》《经济学(季刊)》《世界经济》和China Economic Review等学术期刊发表论文30余篇。研究成果获第四届中国农村发展研究奖论文提名奖、第七届广东省哲学社会科学优秀成果奖三等奖。
data.abstract: 士大夫以天下为己任的政治理想,能否在离开庙堂之后成为推动地方人力资本积累的力量？本文整合中国历代人物传记资料库(CBDB)、进士登科数据库与历史地理资料,采用BJS插补式多时点双重差分方法,考察北宋中央官员到任对地方人力资本的影响。研究发现,中央官员到任后,地方产生文进士的概率与人数显著提高。机制分析表明,教育供给的扩展与地方文化的积累,是士大夫兴学育才理念转化为人才成长的重要渠道。异质性分析显示,科举基础薄弱地区更易突破人才培养约束,曾任中央财政行政职务的官员对应更明显的人才增长。长期分析发现,地方新增人才随后进入官僚体系。本文为理解士大夫精神的社会经济作用提供了系统证据,揭示官员流动如何将知识与治理经验带入地方,并通过科举选才,将地方人力资本积累与国家治理联系起来。

data.speakerBio: 何建军,男,复旦大学现代物理研究所特聘教授,博士生导师。国家自然科学基金杰出青年基金获得者,国家自然科学基金重大项目课题负责人,国家重点研发计划重点专项课题负责人。带领团队依托兰州重离子加速器装置、锦屏深地核天体物理装置、上海光源伽马光SLEGS装置以及国外放射性束流装置,开展天体环境中关键核反应研究。主要研究宇宙中化学元素起源及演化,恒星中核过程对能量产生和恒星演化的影响,以及天体物理现象的产生机制等科学问题。
data.abstract: 中国锦屏地下实验室( CJPL )覆盖岩层厚达 2400 多米,居世界之首。宇宙射线通量比意大利格兰萨索( Gran Sasso )地下实验室还要低大约 100 倍。 CJPL 为稀有天体核反应事件的直接测量提供了独一无二的极低本底测量环境。 本报告将介绍团队基于锦屏深地核天体物理 JUNA 装置开展的关键核天体反应 19 F(p, ag ) 16 O 和 19 F(p, g ) 20 Ne 直接测量实验结果。利用锦屏加速器提供的强流质子束在接近宇宙中第一代恒星感兴趣的伽莫夫能区发现了一个新的共振,揭示了宇宙古老恒星中的钙元素起源之谜。相关研究结果发表在 PRL 和 Nature 上。另外,还将简要介绍未来上海光源伽马光 SLEGS 装置上的核天体物理研究计划。

data.abstract: This work is the first to treat constrained continuous-time MV portfolio selection in the realm of reinforcement learning. We study continuous-time mean--variance portfolio selection with no-shorting constraints and unknown investment opportunity sets from a reinforcement learning (RL) perspective. The problem is a constrained stochastic linear--quadratic control problem for which the entropy-regularized exploratory formulation of Wang et al. (2020) leads to difficulty in theoretical analysis, because enforcing the constraint on the support of randomized policies nullifies the tractable Gaussian exploration. To tackle this challenge, we introduce an auxiliary exploratory problem without entropy in which exploratory policies are still Gaussian whose samples may violate the no-shorting requirement but their means satisfy it. We then prove that, for a suitable choice of exploration variance, the mean of the optimal Gaussian policy of the auxiliary problem coincides with the optimal policy of the original problem. Motivated by this theoretical result, we develop a model-free RL algorithm that learns the optimal policy of the auxiliary (and hence the original) problem directly from trajectory data without estimating the investment opportunity set. A numerical example demonstrates the performance of the proposed algorithm. (Joint with Yutian Wang and Xun Yu Zhou.)

data.abstract: It is well-known that the Craig-Sakamoto theorem establishes the independence of two quadratic forms in normal variates. Replacing the random normal vectors by the random normal matrices and Wishart variates, in this talk, we present interconnections between the independence of linear forms, quadratic forms, trace forms in matrix normal distribution and Wishart distribution. We show that the Craig-Sakamoto theorem still establishes the independence of two quadratic forms in matrix normal distribution, but it does not establish the independence of two quadratic forms in Wishart variates.

data.speakerBio: 方晓峰，清华大学生命科学学院副教授、博士生导师，2025年获A（原杰青）资助。2009年获西北农林科技大学理学学士学位，2015年获北京生命科学研究所&北京协和医学院博士学位，2015和2017年分别于清华大学和英国John Innes Centre从事博士后研究。2020年加入清华大学生命科学学院。实验室主要研究相分离和相转变在细胞对胁迫的感受、应答和记忆过程中的作用及机制。以（共同）通讯作者身份先后在Nature、Cell、Cell Res、Nat Chem Bio等国际期刊发表学术论文多篇。获2021北京市“杰青”和2022青B资助，入选2022“神农英才计划”，获2024年“Rising Stars in Plant Sciences”、2025年中国细胞生物学会青年科学家奖。

曾嘉鸿,北京师范大学心理学博士,现任华南师范大学心理学院特聘副研究员,主要研究方向为语言认知的神经机制,结合大语言模型与机器学习方法,聚焦脑科学与人工智能在语言认知领域的交叉融合。近年来,在 Journal of Neuroscience、Neuroimage、Human Brain Mapping、Cerebral Cortex 等神经科学领域国际权威期刊上发表多篇论文。研究内容涵盖大脑处理文字信息的时空动态特征、双通路语言加工机制、语言相关脑白质可塑性,以及视觉经验剥夺对语言系统的影响等多个议题。在方法上,综合运用神经电生理(如颅内脑电 sEEG)、多模态脑成像(fMRI/sMRI)和神经调控(TMS)等技术手段,研究对象包括健康人群、癫痫患者、脑损伤患者及先天盲人等多样化群体,相关研究成果获得领域内广泛关注与引用。
data.abstract: 本次讲座将围绕近期的两项重要研究展开。第一项主题为 "从甲骨文到脑科学,以象形文字为钥解锁大脑区分'字'与'物'之谜"。人类视觉认知的"两大支柱"——文字与物体,前者是人类文明传承的核心符号系统,后者是个体与物理世界互动的基础。从神经机制上剖析二者的差异,成为理解人类高级脑认知的重要突破口。然而,长期以来,文字与物体识别研究面临一个关键瓶颈:两类刺激在视觉特征(如字形与轮廓)、语音及语义属性上难以精确匹配,所用实验任务亦常有差异,使得观察到的神经活动差异难以归因于认知过程本身,而可能源自外在刺激特性或任务设计。中国象形文字为这一困境提供了独特的解决思路。作为中华文化"观物取象"的智慧结晶,象形文字以简洁线条勾勒物体典型特征,兼具图像直观性与符号抽象性。第一项研究将以此类材料为切入点,采用功能磁共振成像(fMRI)探索语言认知背后的核心神经机制。第二项研究则进一步聚焦于第一项中已识别出的核心大脑枢纽——顶下小叶(IPL),旨在揭示其内部在毫秒级

data.speakerBio: 王强，华南理工大学医学院副院长、二级教授，国家杰出青年科学基金获得者，国家重点研发计划首席科学家。2004年在山东大学获得博士学位，2004-2008年在清华大学生物系从事博士后研究，2008年到中科院动物所任副研究员，2013-2022年任研究员，膜生物学国家重点实验室副主任，2022年到华南理工大学医学院任二级教授，教育部发育与疾病医药基础研究创新中心主任。主要从事胚胎形态发生的分子机制研究，深入探讨胚胎如何由一个形态均一的卵裂球发育为具有明显的头尾、背腹及左右等不对称特征的个体。在Developmental Cell、Nature Cardiovascular Research、Nature Communications 、Science Advances 、Blood 、PLoS Biology 、Development等国际主流期刊发表多篇研究论文。2012年获得教育部自然科学奖二等奖，2013年获得国家优秀青年科学基金资助，2017年获北京市自然科学“十二五”期间优秀成果，2020年获得国家杰出青年科学基金资助，并荣获2020年度中国科学院杰出科技成就奖（集体奖）。担任《中国实验动物学报》副主编，Marine Life Science & Technology编委，中国细胞生物学学会常务理事，中国细胞生物学学会发育生物学分会会长，中国动物学会斑马鱼分会常务理事等学术职务。

data.abstract: In this talk, I will first give a practical tutorial on the multigrid method with a detailed MATLAB implementation (on GitHub). Then I will introduce how to use local Fourier analysis (LFA) to optimize the multigrid smoothers for faster convergence rates. Finally, I will showcase the applications of such LFA techniques to optimize multigrid smoothers in two benchmarking problems: the 2D/3D Poisson equations and the elliptic optimal control problems. Numerical results are reported to support our analysis.

data.abstract: In this talk, we will introduce some results of Forelli-Rudin type operators and Hankel operators. The equivalent characterization for Lp-Lq boundedness and compactness of Forelli-Rudin type operators are obtained. The sufficient and necessary conditions which Hankel operators Hf and Hf are both bounded and compact from Lp to Lq respectively are given.

data.abstract: 混合精度计算在算法的繁重环节(例如 Newton 迭代矫正量的求解)使用低精度浮点数运算, 在算法的轻便环节(例如残差项的计算)使用高精度浮点数运算,这种搭配能同时实现降低整体计算时间和保持最终结果高精度的双重目的。由于 GPU 以及其他低精度芯片的广泛使用,混合精度计算最近十年来在欧美发达国家得到快速发展和广泛应用,大量经典数值方法得到改进以匹配混合精度计算。我们致力于改良常用时间并行算法(如 Parareal, MGRiT,ParaDiag),使之适用于混合精度计算,同时对混精模式下算法的收敛性、稳健性以及参数选择进行分析,并将改良后的算法应用于近场动力学计算、增材制造过程模拟以及热力耦合方程计算等领域。本报告对混合精度时间并行计算的基本思路、常用算法、主要挑战以及若干实际应用进行综合性介绍。

data.speakerBio: 韩耀宗教授现任香港中文大学数学系及中国科学技术大学心理学系客座教授。已经发表SCI论文173余篇,被斯坦福大学John Loannidis教授团队列为世界上被引用次数最多的前2％科学家。他的研究主要集中在计算数学领域及涉及从观测数据中推导出未知参的数反问题,其应用涵盖工程、医学成像和地球物理学、无损检测、环境监测和诊断的关键领域。他的研究工作通常结合偏微分方程数值方法、优化技术和统计建模,以应对复杂的现实挑战。2024年,他担任《边界元工程分析》期刊人工智能驱动技术特刊的客座主编,并同时在香港中文大学教授人工智能的数学基础硕士课程。在研究课程中,指导学生选择研究主题并应用课程中教授的人工智能和数值计算技术进行文献调查、收集和分析数据,并为现实生活中的问题提出解决方案。研究结果发表在高引用的Medical Health学术雜誌上。
data.abstract: Surface reconstruction from point clouds is a fundamental challenge in computer graphics and medical imaging. In this talk, we introduce a novel Square-Highway (SqrHw) Network to explore the application of advanced neural network architectures for an accurate and efficient reconstruction of surfaces from data points. Its performance alongside plain neural networks and a simplified highway network is illustrated through various numerical examples including the reconstruction of simple and complex surfaces, such as spheres, human hands, and intricate models like the Stanford Bunny. We also analyze the impact of factors such as the number of hidden layers, interior and exterior points, and data distribution on surface reconstruction quality. Our results show that the proposed SqrHw architecture outperforms most existing neural network configurations, achieving faster convergence and higher-quality surface reconstructions. Additionally, we demonstrate the SqrHw's ability to predict surfaces over missing data, a valuable feature for challenging applications like medical imaging. Furthermore, our study demonstrates that the proposed SqrHw network yields more stable weight norms and backpropagation gradients compared to the Plain Network architecture. This research not only advances the field of computer graphics but also holds utility for other purposes such as function interpolation and physics-informed neural networks, which integrate multilayer perceptrons into their algorithms.

data.abstract: Universal algebraic geometry is the algebraic geometry over arbitrary algebraic structures. It is a new area of research in modern algebra however there are already various important results here as well as interesting developments of a general theory. The main aim of the universal algebraic geometry is to consider the interaction between algebraic structure of an algebra and its geometrical and logical properties. This theory uses the ideas and treats the problems related to universal algebra, algebraic geometry, algebraic logic and model theory. In this talk we would like to give a small introduction to this large area of knowledge.

data.abstract: The barotropic compressible Navier–Stokes system subject to the Navier-slip boundary conditions in a general two-dimensional bounded simply connected domain is considered. For initial density allowed to vanish, the global existence of strong and weak solutions is established when the shear viscosity is a positive constant and the bulk one proportional to a power of the density with the power bigger than one and a third. It should be mentioned that this result is obtained without any restrictions on the size of initial value. To get over the difficulties brought by boundary, on the one hand, Riemann mapping theorem and the pull-back Green's function method are applied to get a pointwise representation of the effective viscous flux. On the other hand, since the orthogonality is preserved under conformal mapping due to its preservation on the angle, the slip boundary conditions are used to reduce the integral representation to the desired commutator form whose singularities can be cancelled out by using the estimates on the spatial gradient of the velocity.

data.abstract: Human sleep-wake cycles emerge from complex interactions between homeostatic sleep pressure and circadian rhythms. In this study, we extend the Phillips-Robinson model by introducing circadian-dependent dynamic thresholds for sleep and wake transitions, yielding a more physiologically grounded framework for sleep regulation. Using bifurcation analysis, we show that the transition from sustained wakefulness to rhythmic sleep-wake cycles is governed by a saddle-node on invariant circle (SNIC) bifurcation, and that these oscillations become entrained to external 24 h light-dark cues. We analytically derive circadian modulated sleep and wake thresholds, revealing how the interaction between circadian and homeostatic drives governs sleep-wake transitions. Our model captures key physiological phenomena, including: (1)the onset and entrainment of sleep-wake rhythms, (2) immediate sleep onset and partial rebound following sleep deprivation, and (3) sleep fragmentation under shift work-like conditions. These results offer new mechanistic insights into how circadian misalignment alters sleep timing and quality. Together, our findings establish an updated theoretical framework for modeling sleep-wake regulation in both natural and disrupted environments, with implications for shift work management, sleep disorder interventions, and personalized chronotherapy.

data.abstract: Formal and long-term contracts provide employees with insurance against income uncertainties (Holmström, 1983), but they do so at the cost of sacrificing potential opportunities for excessive earnings. As the gig economy rises, employees increasingly prefer short-term contracts, viewing gig jobs on platforms as a buffer against such risks. Consequently, firms adapt by shortening contract durations and increasing the use of employee leasing, which may lead to shifts in the mode of management and production. We empirically explore how labor contracts and production evolve in firms, using data from the China Employer-Employee Survey (CEES). We employ a staggered difference-in-differences (DID) model, adopting the entry of food delivery platforms as a shock to the rise of the gig economy. We find that: (1) the entry of food delivery platforms significantly reduces the likelihood of employment contracts and shortens their duration; (2) these impacts are stronger for frontline or non-technical workers, but weaker for those with consumption commitments (e.g., house mortgages); (3) the impacts are stronger for OEM manufacturers, who can actually take advantage of this shift in the labor market, but weaker for high-tech firms; (4) in response, the average wage for long-term contracts increases, while that for short-term contracts decreases; (5) in addition, firms significantly reduce on-the-job training but increase the adoption of robots in production. By reshaping the labor market, the gig economy not only creates flexibility even in traditional sectors such as manufacturing but also poses challenges for traditional modes of management and production.

data.abstract: We study a two-player nonzero-sum Dynkin game in continuous time, where the payoff functions are not required to satisfy the standard "war of attrition"-type order condition. To address this generalised setting, we establish a verification theorem that yields a system of variational inequalities characterising both the players' payoffs and their strategies at certain Nash equilibria. As an application, we examine convertible bond problems with tax benefits. In the first example, we demonstrate the existence of multiple nontrivial Nash equilibria. In the second example, we consider the case where a bondholder possesses two units of convertible bonds and may convert them sequentially. This leads to a two-stage nonzero-sum game that also violates the usual order condition. A Nash equilibrium is identified numerically. Joint work with David Hobson and Edward Wang 勷勤数学•专家

data.abstract: 在磁矩较小时,强关联低维阻挫体系的自旋、电子、晶格和轨道之间复杂相互作用极易受到量子效应的影响,表现出一系列奇异的物性。例如,二维传统几何阻挫三角晶格反铁磁体在磁场下依次表现出120°相、Ising(上-上-下)相、伞形相等等。近十年来,随着交换阻挫的提出,二维蜂巢体系吸引了科研界的极大兴趣:其零磁场基态虽为非共线锯齿-之字形自旋结构,但是对应的Kitaev模型在磁场下可以诱导出类量子自旋液体行为并且严格求解。尽管这些量子态及修正已经有了大量的理论工作,但是相关自旋激发的实验工作仍然十分有限。我们利用弹性和非弹性中子散射技术对基态及磁场下的各相开展测量,观察到了该系统中的强量子效应。通过与线性和非线性自旋波理论的详细比较,我们发现海森堡相互作用对相关量子态的影响。此外,我们还将对S = 1/2的链状氧化物和5/2的三角晶格反铁磁阻挫材料中量子效应及维度的竞争开展相关讨论。

data.abstract: High-frequency gravitational waves (HFGWs) carry a wealth of information on the early Universe with a tiny comoving horizon and astronomical objects of small scale but with dense energy. In this talk, I will demonstrate that the nearby planets, such as Earth and Jupiter, can be leveraged as a laboratory for detecting the HFGWs [Liu, Ren and Zhang, Phys. Rev. Lett. 132 , 131402]. These GWs are then expected to convert to signal photons in the planetary magnetosphere, across the frequency band of astronomical observation. As a proof of concept, I will show the first limits from the existing low-Earth-orbit satellite for specific frequency bands and project the sensitivities for the future more-dedicated detections. The first limits from Juno, the latest mission orbiting Jupiter, are also presented. Thanks to the long path of effective GW-photon conversion and the wide angular distribution of signal flux, the obtained limits are found to be highly encouraging, for a broad frequency range including a large portion unexplored before.

data.speakerBio: Mingjie Xin is a postdoctoral research fellow at Nanyang Technological University, where he also completed his PhD. His research focuses on quantum sensing and precision measurement using cold atoms, with a particular emphasis on developing atom interferometers trapped in optical waveguides. He is also exploring methods for the rapid creation of quantum degenerate gases and developing atom interferometers that operate with these quantum gases, both for probing fundamental physics and advancing applied inertial sensing technologies.
data.abstract: Atom interferometry is a versatile technique utilized for the precise measurement of fundamental constants, such as the Newtonian gravitational constant and the fine-structure constant, while also serving as a powerful tool for testing general relativity and exploring new physics. At the same time, atom interferometers are currently moving out of the laboratory, working as highly sensitive quantum sensors for various applications, such as gravimeters, inertial sensing for navigation, and probing geodesy and geophysics. In typical atom interferometers, precision is limited by the time scale of the measurement, which, in turn, is constrained by the distance that the atoms drop. Miniaturization of interferometer setups typically reduces its performance, thereby limiting its applications. To address this, coherent manipulation of guided ultra-cold atoms has been attempted, with the aim of enhancing the performance of atom interferometers and further developing miniaturized quantum devices. In this talk, I will present our efforts in confining cold atoms in a hollow-core photonic crystal fiber and highlight several key cold-atom experiments investigated in this hollow-core waveguide environment. In the second part of this talk, I will demonstrate the realization of rapid quantum squeezing that overcomes the quantum speed limit using atoms trapped in optical lattice. This achievement holds potential applications for quantum-enhanced sensing and continuous-variable quantum information processing. Finally, I will highlight our recent breakthroughs in direct laser cooling of atoms to Bose-Einstein condensate without the necessity for time-consuming evaporative cooling methods. This enables us to use BEC as a robust and fast source for feeding an interferometer with a bright solitonic matter wave in a horizontal optical waveguide. The results demonstrate the high potential of interferometers operated with quantum gases for probing the fundamental concepts of quantum mechanics and general relativity.

data.abstract: In this talk, we discuss multi dark photon signatures at collider experiments such as LHC and future Z-factories realized by CEPC and FCCee. Dark photon appears with a new scalar boson from spontaneously broken hidden U(1) gauge symmetry. Typically mass scales of dark photon and new scalar are similar size. Thus it is promising to consider signals at collider experiments taking both dark photon and scalar into account. Focusing on light dark photon/scalar scenario, we discuss lepton jets signature at the LHC and a triple dark photon signal at Z-factory. We find these signals are useful to explore kinetic mixing and scalar mixing parameters.

data.abstract: In this talk, we study delay fractional equations. We show that that the regularity of the solution at s+ is better than that at 0+, where s is a constant time delay. Improved regularity of the solution is obtained by the decomposition technique and a fitted L1 numerical scheme is designed for it. We then construct a corrected L1 scheme, of which optimal convergence order reaches 2 - α, where α∈(0, 1) is the order of the Caputo derivative. Significantly, the correction terms share the same forms as the discrete convolution structure for the derivative, which implies that the computation and analysis of these two parts can be integrated together. Finally, error pointwise estimates of L1 method for delay fractional equations are derived by discrete Laplace transform method.

data.abstract: 我们在电磁学、光学和声学中都学过谐振腔,它主要用于放大信号。在量子信息科技领域,我们利用光学谐振腔来增强光子与原子之间的相互作用。在我们的实验中,这种相互作用能够被放大几万倍,从而实现对原子与光相互作用的精准调控,达到单光子和单原子的精度。在教科书中,我们了解到谐振腔内的场是驻波场,驻波具有波腹和波节。其中,波腹处的振幅最大,而波节处的场强为零。为了实现原子与光波的最强耦合,我们通常会想到将原子精准地放置在驻波的波腹处,因为那里场强最大。然而,在我们的实验中,我们实现了一种特殊的共振光场,光场为零的波节能够自动锁定在原子的位置。我们利用一个光学环形腔与原子阵列的强耦合系统,生成了一个光学暗态。在这个暗态中,原子阵列激发生成光学腔的驻波,并且使光场的节点与原子完全重合,从而将原子完全屏蔽在光场之外。这种暗态避免了原子散射导致的光子损失,从而实现了高效的光子转换。这一实验提供了一种基于原子阵列空间结构调控光子-光子相互作用的新方法,为全光量子信息处理和量子网络应用开辟了新的可能性。

data.abstract: In this talk, which is non-technical and meant for a general audience, the speaker will share some interesting facts about networks. A network comprises nodes, and links between them. For example, the nodes may be people (in which case we call the network a "social network") where the links denote friendships that exist between the nodes (such a network is called a "friendship network"). As another example, the nodes may be webpages, with links being hyperlinks between them (this network is nothing but the World Wide Web). Networks are ubiquitous, and influence our lives in fundamental and sometimes hidden ways. You are part of a social network (as we all are). To what extent are you influenced by your network? Who are the most influential members in your network? Is it fair for you to compare yourself with other members in the network? This talk is expository in nature. It contains no original content.

data.abstract: This talk is mainly concerned with the free boundary problem for an approximate model of a gas bubble of finite mass enclosed within a bounded incompressible viscous liquid, accounting for surface tensions at both the gas-liquid interface and the external free surface of the entire gas-liquid region. It is found that any regular spherically symmetric steady-state solution is characterized by a positive root of a ninth-degree polynomial for which the existence and uniqueness are proved and a one-to-one correspondence between equilibria and pairs of gas mass and liquid volume is established, by a rescaling argument. We prove that these equilibria exhibit nonlinear and exponential asymptotic stability. Moreover, we construct a global center manifold. Furthermore, we derive the optimal exponential decay rate for small liquid volumes by analyzing the spectrum bounds of the associated linear operator, This talk is based on joint work with Chengchun Hao and Siqi Yang.

data.abstract: We study the damped compressible Euler-Maxwell system, a classical model describing the interaction of electrons with electromagnetic waves in semiconductor devices. First, we prove the global existence of classical solutions to the Cauchy problem for small perturbations of the constant equilibrium within a critical regularity framework, uniformly with respect to the relaxation parameter. Next, we derive global error estimates with a sharp convergence rate between the scaled Euler-Maxwell system and the limiting drift-diffusion model in the case of ill-prepared data. To achieve our results, we develop a new characterization of the dissipation structure for the Euler-Maxwell system with respect to the relaxation parameter. This involves partitioning the frequency space into three distinct regimes: low, medium, and high frequencies, associated with different behaviors of the solution. In different frequency regimes, the Lyapunov functionals based on the hypocoercivity theory are used to establish uniform a priori estimates. In addition, the global-in-time convergence rate is obtained by using an effective unknown associated with Darcy's law. This work is a collaboration with Dr. Timothée Crin-Barat, Prof. Yue-Jun Peng and Prof. Jiang Xu.

data.abstract: 在眼科或耳鼻喉科研究中,当从每个受试者身上测量涉及成对器官(如眼睛、耳朵)的观察结果时,通常会出现双侧相关数据。基于Donner(1989)提出的模型,本文通过对双边相关数据的逻辑回归分析,重点研究了疾病概率与协变量(如年龄、体重、性别等)之间的关系。我们首先提出了一种新的被受控--最大化(MM)算法和一种快速的二次下界(QLB)算法来计算回归系数向量的最大似然估计,然后发展了三个大样本检验(即似然比检验、Wald检验和得分检验)来检验协变量是否对疾病概率有显著影响。通过仿真研究来评估所提出的快速QLB算法和三个检验方法的表演。伊朗的一个真实眼科数据集用于说明所提出的方法。

data.abstract: 神经网络在新一轮人工智能热潮中扮演基础性作用。人们非常关心它能否举一反三,也就是泛化能力。但不幸的是,好的泛化能力往往带来弱的鲁棒性,即容易受无关紧要的数据噪声的影响。如何协调这两者的矛盾？本报告将用物理学的思想解决这一矛盾,提出了费米-玻色机。最后展望该机器及其算法的潜在应用。

data.abstract: 近二十年来,拓扑物态引起了科研工作者的广泛研究兴趣。研究人员提出了多种具有新奇物理性质的拓扑态,但是在凝聚态量子材料中实现和应用这些新奇物态受到材料制备、极端条件、调控技术等多方面的限制。而拓扑物态的物理本质源于波函数的几何相位,因此在具有波动性质的电子线路中可以实现类似的新奇拓扑态。与凝聚态量子材料相比,电子线路具有的样品制备相对容易,调控自由度高,测量技术成熟等优势,在近年来引起了广泛研究兴趣。

data.abstract: 光原子钟基于光学波段的原子跃迁，相比微波原子钟具有更高的精度，有望在时间标准、国家授时、卫星导航等领域得到广泛应用。光原子钟运行通常采用荧光探测，利用拉姆齐序列将激光频率锁定到特定的原子跃迁。为延长荧光积分时间、提高光钟的精度，通常需要避免原子系综发生快速的集体辐射衰减，即超辐射过程。然而，过去十几年的研究表明，光钟的稳态超辐射具有毫赫兹的超窄线宽，有望直接用于主动光钟并提高其精度。在这个报告中，我将介绍近期在这一研究方向开展的几个理论工作，重点探讨差频测量对频率精度的影响，量子测量反馈作用对原子系综动力学的影响，以及基于延迟超辐射的频率测量机制。

data.abstract: 社交网络在建立人与人之间的联系和整个社会的非正式信息传递方面发挥着至关重要的作用。虽然已有研究者开始研究在二人互动和极小群体( 1-6人)中参与社会学习的大脑计算,但对于个体在社会网络中互动时的大脑机制却知之甚少。这次的讲座将介绍4个研究,可以让我们了解大脑如何在社交网络中进行推理的机制铺平了道路,提供对信息传递的多层次理解,整合大脑系统水平以及个人和集体行为水平。

data.abstract: In recent years, topological superconductors have attracted significant attention as a canonical example of topological phases of matter which host exotic Majorana quasiparticles. Majorana zero modes (MZMs), exhibiting non-Abelian statistics, are predicted to exist in these systems–either as end states in one-dimensional topological superconductors or as vortex bound states in two dimensional topological superconductors. In addition to the fundamental physical interest, MZMs provide a practical avenue for information processing in future fault-tolerant quantum computers as well. Here, we report our two works on topological superconductivity: (1) Inspired by the intense attention on quasi-2D kagome superconductors AV3Sb5 (A = K, Rb, and Cs) with unexpected chiral flux phase (CFP), we bridge the gap between topological superconductivity and time-reversal asymmetric CFP in kagome systems. Several chiral topological superconductor (TSC) states and the related transport properties have been studied. (2) We highlight a situation having attracted little attention previously that in two-dimensional topological nodal superconductors, the Majorana edge states with breaking chiral symmetry but preserving nearly flat bands can have unexpected spin-singlet component of pairing correlations compared with the counterparts of exactly flat bands.

data.abstract: 快速识别凸显物体( salient objects )对于动物生存有着重要的意义。这可以使得我们能够尽快躲避捕食者的袭击,起到危险警示的作用。除了目标之外,凸显的分心影响我们视觉搜索,但这背后的加工机制的认识依旧不太清晰。并且,尽管在猴子上已经进行大量关于注意捕获的神经机制的研究,但在人类上依旧缺乏关于注意捕获的神经机制的研究。本次报告针对该问题展开,介绍我们通过分析病人的颅内电极数据,利用反向编码模型( Inverted encoding model ),成功从颞叶和前扣带回皮层中提出与注意捕获有关的信号。该结果揭示人类对于凸显物体的加工更多地是源于前扣带皮层和颞叶,而非传统观点所认为的前额叶和顶叶等脑区,颠覆了人类对于这一现象的认知。

data.abstract: In this talk, we are concerned with the Hamiltonian elliptic system in dimension two involving exponential nonlinearities. When the potential admits one or several local strict minimum points, we show the existence and concentration of single-peak and multi-peak semiclassical states. In addition, positivity of solutions and uniqueness of local maximum points of solutions are also studied. Our theorems extend the results of Ramos and Tavares [Calc. Var. 31 (2008) 1-25], where the nonlinearities have polynomial growth. It seems that it is the first attempt to obtain multi-peak semiclassical states for Hamiltonian elliptic system with exponential growth.

data.abstract: 目前光钟的准确度和稳定度都比国际上目前用于“秒”定义的铯原子喷泉钟高出两个数量级以上，光钟不仅是基础研究的有力工具，极有可能成为下一代的时间频率基准。但由于光钟系统的复杂性导致其体积庞大，且无法连续运行，这已成为光钟走向实际应用的瓶颈。本次演讲主要是围绕如何将实验室庞大的光钟系统进行小型化设计和如何提高光钟整体的运行率方面的研究工作。探索光钟光钟驾驭氢钟的守时系统以及其频差测量、频差模型建立和驾驭策略关键技术研究，建立长期稳定度为优于E-17量级的光学原子时系统，为未来秒定义变更和新型的授时系统形成重要的技术储备。

data.abstract: The physical properties in magnetic-ordered materials were ultimately believed to rely on the symmetry theory of magnetic groups. Recently, it has come to light that a more comprehensive group, known as spin (crystallographic) group, which combines separate spin and spatial operations, is necessary to fully characterize the geometry and underlying properties of magnetic-ordered materials such as altermagnets . In this talk, we introduce the recent developments of spin group theory, including extensive enumeration of over 100000 spin space groups, identification of spin groups for collinear, coplanar, and noncoplanar configurations, and irreducible co-representations in momentum space leading to more energy degeneracies that are disallowed by magnetic groups. We further show some theoretical and experimental results of spin group applications in understanding physical effects beyond the framework of magnetic groups. Examples include unconventional antiferromagnets with spin splitting, new quasiparticles in antiferromagnet CoNb3S6, and correlation-enhanced spin-orbit coupling effect.

data.abstract: Dissipation is unavoidable in quantum systems. It usually induces decoherences and changes quantum correlations. To access the information of strongly correlated quantum matters, one has to overcome or suppress dissipation to extract out the underlying quantum phenomena. However, here we find an opposite effect that dissipation can be utilized as a powerful tool to probe the intrinsic correlations of quantum many-body systems. Applying highly- controllable dissipation in ultracold atomic systems, we observe a universal dissipative dynamics in strongly correlated one-dimensional quantum gases. The total particle number of this system follows a universal stretched-exponential decay, and the stretched exponent measures the anomalous dimension of the spectral function, a critical parameter characterizing strong quantum fluctu- ations of this system. This method could have broad applications in detecting strongly correlated features, including spin-charge separations and Fermi arcs in quantum materials.

data.abstract: Given a 1-D G-normal random variable (RV) X, a trinomial tree method is proposed to approximate the G-Expectation E[φ(X)] for any test function φ. The method is stable and convergent. There is no need to worry about the boundary condition. Furthermore, the whole numerical process actually yields the samples to estimate the expectation E[φ(X)]. As we know, direct sampling for a G-normal RV X is infeasible due to the uncertainty of its distribution. But for a `measurement' E[φ(X)], the sampling is feasible. This is just like an measurement on quantum state: before measurement, the state is uncertain and unknown, after measurement, the state is definite.

data.abstract: 加快建设统一大市场,劳动力畅通流动最为重要,但劳动力流动的堵点缺乏跨时期的评估,以致于形成了跨省流动趋弱的认识。本文利用2000-2015年人口普查数据,识别了省界、方言、自然地理和距离对城市间移民的影响。研究发现,在控制了山川河流、方言和距离等非制度障碍后,省界分割仍会显著降低城市间的移民规模,其效应有增强的趋势。但这一趋势是因为省间劳动力市场一体化滞后于省内一体化,例如,人口流出地省份实现养老保险省级统筹可以显著降低个体跨省流动概率,而人口流入城市高落户门槛强化省界分割效应。同时,尽管流入地第三产业的发展会减弱省界壁垒的效应,但会强化方言对人口流动的阻碍作用。我们还证实,省界、方言和地理距离这些劳动力流动障碍,扩大了人口流入地和流出地的收入差距。因此,要缩小地区间收入差距,必须凝聚共识,进一步畅通跨省的劳动力流动。

data.abstract: Tensor Networks (TNs) are factorizations of high dimensional tensors into networks of many low-dimensional tensors, which have been studied in quantum physics, high-performance computing, and applied mathematics. In recent years, TNs have been increasingly investigated and applied to machine learning and signal processing, due to its significant advances in handling large-scale and high-dimensional problems, model compression in deep neural networks, and efficient computations for learning algorithms. This talk aims to present some recent progress of TNs technology applied to machine learning from perspectives of basic principle and algorithms, novel approaches in unsupervised learning, tensor completion, multi-model learning and various applications in DNN, CNN, RNN and etc.

data.abstract: Magneto-rotational instability (MRI) is an important instability mechanism for rotating flows with magnetic field. In particular, when the strength of the magnetic field tends to zero, the stability criterion for rotating flow is different from the classical Rayleigh criterion for rotating flow without magnetic field. MRI had found many physical applications, for example in the explanation of turbulence and momentum transport in accretion disks. We gave the first rigorous proof of linear MRI and a complete description of the spectra. Moreover, we prove nonlinear stability and instability from the linear stability/instability criteria. This work is joint with Zhiwu Lin and Wenpei Wu.

data.abstract: 光是地球上最重要的环境因子之一，它不仅是植物光合作用的能量来源，也是植物生长发育的决定性信号。植物由几类不同的光受体来感知和传递不同波长的光，如蓝光受体隐色素CRY(Cryptochrome)、ZTL(ZEITLUPE)、向光素PHOT(Phototropin)、紫外光UV - B受体UVR8(UV RESISTANCE LOCUS 8)和红光受体光敏素PHY(Phytochrome)。光信号通过这些光受体调节植物整个生长发育过程，如光形态建成、开花时间以及生物钟等。植物能否有效地对光环境的变化做出反应，决定其自身能否正常生长、发育和繁殖。

data.abstract: 近三十多年,放射性核束的产生使得人类可研究的核素版图持续扩大,远离稳定线原子核(特别是丰中子原子核)展现出一系列新现象和新规律,并与天体中元素生成过程以及攀登超重稳定岛路径等密切相关。但目前实验室可达到的丰中子核素区域仍然很有限,特别是被称为世纪谜题的天体 r-过程(快中子过程)所涉及的核素尚难以企及,由此成为下阶段国际基础科学研究竞争的焦点之一。本报告将介绍新一代强流电子束驱动ISOL装置(HEISOL),它采用两种类型的强流电子加速方案,预计可以产生30 MeV、3.5mA(功率100 kW)强流电子束和300MeV/kA超快电子束流。此后强流电子束与固体靶作用,可以驱动光核裂变结合同位素在线分离(ISOL)的方式产生高纯度高流强的中等质量区极端丰中子核,以此为基础探索原子核奇特结构和核天体的重大科学问题。

data.abstract: First, we study the rotation effects of the hot and dense QCD matter in a non-perturbative regime by the gauge/gravity duality. We use the gravitational model that is designated to match the state-of-the-art lattice data on the thermal properties of (2+1)-flavor QCD and predict the location of the critical endpoint and the first-order phase transition line at large baryon chemical potential without rotation. After introducing the angular velocity via a local Lorentz boost, we investigate the thermodynamic quantities for the system under rotation in a self-consistent way. We find that the critical temperature and baryon chemical potential associated with the QCD phase transition decrease as the angular velocity increases. Moreover, some interesting phenomena are observed near the critical endpoint. Secondly we calculate the spectral function and dissociation of the heavy vector mesons with the presence of an intense magnetic field in a hot and dense medium. The energy loss of heavy quark in a Magnetized thermal dense QCD matter is also studied. We find that the drag force of heavy quark and jet quenching parameter behave an enhancement near the phase transition temperature. The peak values of drag force and jet quenching parameter are pushed towards lower temperature with increasing B or μ. The heavy quark may lose more energy when perpendicular to magnetic field which is consistent with the results of jet quenching parameter.

data.abstract: The linear multiplicative programming problem arises from numerous applications such as network flows and financial optimization. data.abstract: 最优化方法是最接地气的应用数学,科学与工程计算中出现的许多优化问题都可以归结为一个变分不等式。听起来比较陌生的变分不等式其实就是"瞎子爬山判别是否到达顶点"的数学表达式。利用普通的大学数学和一般的优化原理,以变分不等式为基本工具,我们做出一些被国际同行知名学者誉为"Very Simple yet Powerful"和"Elegant"的工作。我们给出的算法统一框架,收敛性证明主要依靠一个初等的积化和差的恒等式,利用一些分块矩阵的知识,就可以相当容易地设计出一簇凸优化的分裂收缩方法。我们的研究实践再一次证明,简单的方法,才比较容易被工程界采用,转化成生产力。 学术

data.abstract: 父母与其子女在学业成就中的相似性可能来源于基因遗传的作用或通过抚养教育的影响。最新的研究表明,即使是父母未遗传给后代的基因仍通过环境的中介作用非直接地影响其发展,这一现象被称为"遗传养育"。该研究通过多层随机效应模型整合了来自不同样本来源与文化背景的关于遗传养育效应在教育中作用的证据,得出了普适的遗传养育效应效果量以及父母基因直接作用于后代对其结果的"直接遗传效应"效果量。检测了诸多变量的调节作用并证明了遗传养育效应超越样本来源、文化背景、基因来源(父亲 / 母亲)、研究设计等诸多方面影响的稳定性。验证了经济条件对于教育结果的重要调节作用,推论了父母未遗传给后代的基因影响其教育可能的中介因素。通过详尽的敏感性分析,充分证明了研究结果的可信度。同时,通过在开放科学平台预注册研究方案以及随文发表所有研究代码保证了研究的透明度及结果的可重复性。

data.abstract: We study the 3D array image data completion, robust principal component analysis (PCA), and multi-view subspace clustering problems via a non-convex low-rank representation under the framework of tensors. Most of the recent studies of tensor-based linear models use the Tensor Nuclear Norm (TNN) as a convex surrogate of the tensor rank. However, since the tensor nuclear norm is linearly proportional to the sum of singular values, the tensor rank approximation by using the tensor nuclear norm may become problematic if the ratios of the nonzero singular values are far away being from 1. Some non-convex tensor-based functions are proposed as the objective function regularizer, aiming to achieve a better tensor low-rank approximation. A corresponding algorithm associated with the augmented Lagrangian multipliers is established and the constructed convergent sequence to the desirable Karush--Kuhn--Tucker (KKT) critical point solution is mathematically validated in detail. Extensive simulations on eight benchmark image datasets are provided, along with full comparisons with the latest existing approaches. The obtained results demonstrate that our proposed method significantly outperforms those convex approaches currently available in the literature. 学术

data.abstract: Turing-type reaction-diffusion systems on evolving domains and on rough surfaces are considered in this talk. For RDS on the evolving domain, the kernel-based collocation method is applied after transforming the PDE into the reference domain. A global refinement strategy is proposed to reduce the computational cost. The convergence behavior of the proposed algorithm and the effectiveness of the refinement strategy are verified. For RDS on the rough surfaces, we consider periodic rough surfaces with analytic parametric equations. The amplitude of such surfaces is an important variable in the provided eigenvalue analysis for the Laplace-Beltrami operator. Simulations show that the patterns become irregular as the amplitude and frequency of the rough surface increase. To further generalize to solve RDS on closed manifolds, we propose another construction method of rough surfaces by using random nodal values and discretized heat filters. Numerical evidence shows that both surface constructions yield comparable patterns to those found in real-life animals. 学术

data.abstract: We analyze whether preferential trade agreements (PTAs) affect the incidence and pattern of antidumping (AD) filings. We find PTA membership results in a 29 percent (15 percent) decrease in the incidence of intra-PTA AD actions (measures). We then exploit variation in the content of PTAs and find the reduction is due to PTAs with explicit AD rules. We find that intra-PTA AD filings (measures) decrease by about 46 percent (34 percent) for PTAs with explicit AD rules. Our results are robust to controlling for other PTA-related phenomena, the emergence of China as the largest target of AD actions, and the role played by EU and US PTAs. Our findings highlight the effectiveness of PTA AD rules in curbing AD disputes among members.

data.abstract: 研究和寻找超出传统夸克模型的多夸克态结构(即奇特强子态)是非微扰强相互作用研究的热点。自从实验上发现奇特强子态候选者 X(3872) 以来,陆续又发现的一系列奇特强子态候选者,尤其是 2021 年发现的双粲介子 Tcc ,极大地推动了奇特强子态实验和理论研究。随着实验精度的提高,理论研究方法也在不断发展。本报告将主要介绍 X(3872) 和 Tcc 在重离子对撞中的产生,以及利用机器学习方法研究奇特强子态性质的新尝试。

data.abstract: 安德森局域是凝聚态中的最基本最重要的现象之一,迁移率边是安德森局域转变中最核心的概念。本次报告先介绍一下安德森局域,然后根据扩展态和局域态展现出的不同的输运行为引入迁移率边研究的意义以及我们为什么要研究一维准周期系统中的迁移率边。最后,我将重点介绍我们在可精确求解的迁移率边模型和新型迁移率边相关方面的研究进展。

data.abstract: 从微波到光波的高效率、大带宽的相干转换是实现超导量子比特长距离通信以及分布式量子计算的关键科学问题之一。目前国际上正在尝试多种技术线路来实现微波 - 光波相干转换,而基于多波混频过程的原子或类原子体系是目前发展最快的微波 - 光波转换方案之一,有望成为实用化的量子网络节点。本报告将回顾该领域近年来所取得的进展,主要介绍我们最近通过里德堡原子六波混频演示高效率微波 - 光波相干转换的工作。

data.abstract: The rising of topological materials MnBi2Te4/(Bi2Te3)n with built-in magnetization provides a great platform for the realization of both Chern-insulator and axion-insulator phases, manifesting integer and half-integer quantum anomalous Hall (QAH) effects, respectively. Using both model Hamiltonian and first-principles calculations, they demonstrate that rich 2D and 3D topological phase diagrams can be established with the mapping of MnBi2Te4/(Bi2Te3)n systems. For the 2D topological phases, they provide design principles to trigger integer QAH states by tuning experimentally accessible knobs, such as slab thickness and magnetization. For the 3D topological phases, they find that the surface anomalous Hall conductivity in the axion-insulator phase is a well-localized hanging around e2/2h, depending on the magnetic homogeneity. They then discuss the potential experimental signatures of the surface anomalous Hall effect in MnBi2Te4/(Bi2Te3)n.

data.abstract: 本研究通过大数据实证分析了影响中国上市公司违约风险的关键因素,揭示了不同行业、不同地区和不同所有制形式上市公司的信用特征和清偿能力之间的差别。并在国家自然科学基金重点项目(71731003)的资助下,建立了以违约概率为核心的信用评级体系。一是测算中国上市公司每家企业2000~2018年这19年间的违约概率,预测2019-2023年这5年每家上市公司的违约概率,揭示影响中国上市公司违约风险的关键因素。二是通过样本信用得分均值的曼惠特尼U检验,揭示不同行业上市公司的信用特征,包括全部上市公司、制造行业、批发零售行业、全部上市小企业、制造行业上市小企业等14个样本或行业的信用特征;不同地区上市公司的信用特征,包括北京、上海、广东省等31个省份的信用特征;不同所有制上市公司的信用特征,包括中央国有企业、民营企业、外资企业等全部7个所有制形式;不同行业和不同地区上市公司的信用特征,如制造行业在全国31个地区的信用特征;特定行业不同所有制上市公司的信用特征,如制造行业的7种所有制类型的信用特征。

data.abstract: 理工科人才对于中国建设世界科技强国尤为重要。本文以国家自然科学基金为切入点,利用2003-2019年全国高校毕业生就业调查数据检验了基础研究投入对理工科毕业生就业的影响。研究发现,自然科学基金资助显著提升了理工科毕业生的工资水平,尤其是青年研究者的资助项目发挥了主要的作用。机制分析表明,基金资助显著增加了学生的课题研究机会和课外实习机会,并且改善了教学辅助设施与实验条件,推动学生和与老师合作发表了数量更好和质量更好的学术论文。进一步研究发现,基金资助不仅提高了毕业生升学的概率,还有助于毕业生获得能解决户口和档案、雇佣期限更长、专业对口度更高的工作。

data.abstract: 航运市场与大宗商品市场、金融市场是现代全球经济的重要组成部分,反映了物流-货物-资金的资源配置。航运、公路、铁路等交通大数据隐含了大宗商品等货物运输过程的全部信息,这些信息为大宗商品、金融市场的价格预测和风险管理提供了一个全新视角。 第一,回溯航运市场的历史发展,梳理航运市场与金融市场相伴而生的发展逻辑。介绍了航运市场的资本密集性、周期性、季节性和高风险性四个特点,并从金融视角解释针对航运市场特点的金融支持。 第二,介绍了航运金融的四个核心:航运指数、船舶融资、航运衍生品、航运保险。尽管中国已成为航运大国,但在航运高端服务业——航运金融,距离国际领先仍然存在很大距离。 第三,介绍了航运金融领域的最新发展动力:航运大数据、人工智能技术。作为信息技术发展的代表性成果航运大数据,中国在此领域并不落后。同时,中国在人工智能技术领域占据领先地位。这是我们发展航运金融、实现后来居上的重要技术支撑。 第四,介绍了航运金融领域技术发展的新进展。包括:基于大数据的航运指数设计,为掌握航运市场国际定价权、实现航运-大宗商品交叉市场预测提供新的技术手段;船舶融资的动态风险识别,实现船舶信用风险动态识别和预警;基于航运衍生品的二手船估值,为船舶价值套期保值、风险管理提供技术支撑;航运保险的风险管理,为保险公司提供航运价格保险精算技术,实现普惠保险。 结束语,介绍了大连海事大学航运金融的科研团队和科研平台。

data.abstract: There have been large differences in economic development among regions and cities in China since the country embraced market-based reforms in the late 1970s. This in-equality in spatial development has caused large internal migration flows as households from rural areas have sought economic opportunities for themselves and their children in urban areas. We document that internal migrants, who did not obtain full residency rights, have not enjoyed the same access to local public goods and services as city residents. In particular, unequal access to educational opportunities implies that children of migrants have lower levels of human capital accumulation than children of residents. The internal migration controls, therefore, create barriers to mobility across the income and wealth distributions within China. We develop a spatial overlapping generations model with heterogeneous households to study the feasibility of alternative internal migration policies that offer the potential of decreasing the inequality within China while at the same time increasing the level of human capital accumulation in the economy. We show that these reforms are feasible, but require significant tax increases to offset the reduction of the positive fiscal externalities provided by migrants.

data.abstract: In this paper, we examine the impact of bank green credit on firm green innovation, which is accurately measured by a machine learning approach. Using a difference-in-difference (DID) strategy, we find that green patents of environmentally friendly firms increased significantly after the implementation of green bank credit policy. This suggests that green credit policy improved the green innovation of environmentally friendly firms. Two mechanisms are responsible for this finding: on the one hand, more loans are available for environmentally friendly firms; on the other hand, less rent-seeking behaviors are required for these firms. Moreover, we find that the effect of green credit policy is more pronounced for firms that rely less on internal financing and firms that located in high banking development provinces. Finally, we find that bank green credit also improves the quality of green innovation to a higher extent. 华师经英seminar吸引了经济与管理学院广大师生参与,促进了学院内部学术交流。

data.abstract: While there is mounting evidence of the positive impact of reminders on individual decisions, little is known whether the frequency of reminders matters. In a field experiment that lasted for about nine weeks and was conducted in the People's Republic of China, we assess the impact of the frequency of reminders (no reminder, one-off reminder, one reminder a week sent in the first four weeks, two reminders a week sent in the first four weeks) on the probability of paying overdue property taxes. We illustrate that frequent reminders approximately double the probability of paying overdue taxes compared to a one-off reminder and result in substantial fiscal gains. We also find that one reminder a week considerably boosts the probability of tax compliance compared to a one-off reminder (the increase is around 40%), while two reminders a week are not that influential compared to one reminder a week (the increase is around 10%). The takeaway of our study is that frequent reminders are an important trigger for human behavior, nonetheless, beyond a certain frequency the effectiveness of additional reminders seems to decline.

data.abstract: Inspiredby partial forward integration practices, this study investigates how asupplier allocates the capacity of a key component between the supplier andmultiple external manufacturers by incorporating the endogenous relationshipbetween bargaining power and capacity allocation. Each firm can use thecomponent to produce substitutable final products. We analyze the equilibriumoutcomes when the supplier and the manufacturers have inherently differentcost-efficiencies in producing and selling the final product. We show thatunder endogenous bargaining power, the supplier may allocate partial componentcapacity internally for his own production even when the supplier's and themanufacturers' products are perfect substitutes and the supplier has a costdisadvantage. This provides a strategic perspective for the coexistence of bothcooperative and competitive relationships between the supplier and themanufacturers and the phenomena of partial forward integration. Interestingly,the supplier may allocate more capacity internally on becoming lesscost-efficient in the final product and may allocate asymmetrically for thecost-symmetric manufacturers and symmetrically for the cost-asymmetricmanufacturers. Our main insights extend to settings with imperfect product substitutionand alternative outside options of the supplier.

A 96, 061603(R) (2017)]。基于这些工作,我们研究了具有自旋轨道耦合的方形光晶格中的强关联超冷玻色系统的自旋序,在实空间玻色动力学平均场理论的框架下,我们得到了不同自旋轨道耦合强度情况下在Mott绝缘区和超流区的基态自旋相图。基于自旋超交换相互作用理论,我们分析了该自旋相图产生的微观原理。 另外,我也将简要介绍我们在激光诱导三层石墨烯结构相变方面的工作。理解激光和物质相互作用有助于解决控制材料结构、优化器件性能。我们研究在机械解离的三层石墨烯材料中实现了由激光辐照诱导的从ABC到ABA的结构相变[Light Sci Appl 9, 174 (2020)]。并且通过第一原理的计算理解了这一不可逆相变过程的微观机理,对实现超快相变存储等纳米器件具有重要指导意义。

data.abstract: We can visually interpret a complex image at a glance. Who is there? What is there? Where is this place? Such recognition requires our brain to reduce the rich and high-dimensional visual information mapped onto the retina into low-dimensional representations that guide the perceptual decision. In the first part of my talk, I will introduce how we can tease apart stimulus information that supports decisions from that which does not, using a data-driven approach. Then I will show you the brain processes related to the two components: 1) reduction of behaviorally irrelevant information, and 2) the construction of behavioral representations. In the second part of my task, I will illustrate the reduced representations enable us to perform an efficient and versatile recognition, using a case study about individual face identification.

data.abstract: The nucleon and nuclear structures are difficult to understand from the first principle due to the still unresolved problems of the nonperturbative physics of the gauge theory and the quantum many-body problem. The resolutions of these issues are one of the most important goals, first from the point-of-view of the understanding of fundamental physics, and second because nucleons and nuclei are experimentally used to unveil the new physics beyond the current frontier. One of the attractive approaches to tackle these problems is the computational physics. Motivated by the above background, I calculated many quantities related to the hadronic and nuclear structures using various numerical methods. In this seminar, I will present my past work and results based on several numerical approaches which are lattice QCD, quantum few-body calculations, and numerical perturbative QCD computations.

data.abstract: The Reagan Revolution cut deeply into the dominant Democratic coalition that began with the New Deal Democrats. data.abstract: This paper theoretically and empirically examines how fertility decline induced by the one-child policy has affected intergenerational mobility in China. I present a human capital investment model incorporating fertility and credit constraints, and show that fertility decline narrows the educational attainment gap between children from credit-constrained families and non-credit-constrained families, thus increasing intergenerational mobility. I then empirically test the model's prediction using variation in the implementation intensity of the one-child policy across regions and cohorts addressing the endogeneity of the fertility decision. I confirm that lower fertility increases intergenerational mobility, and that the one-child policy played an under-appreciated role in changing intergenerational mobility in China.

data.abstract: Episodic memory refers to the ability remembering individual items and contextual details that surround these items. This memory ability develops rapidly and significantly during early childhood. Animal and human studies have indicated that hippocampus is an important neural structure underlying episodic memory. However, it is still unclear regarding how the structural and functional development of hippocampus fosters the development of episodic memory in early childhood. I will address how we use neuroimaging methods to investigate the neural substrates underlying the development of episodic memory in early childhood, including (1) event-related potentials (ERP) is used to examine the developmental trajectories of episodic memory in early childhood, (2) ultra-high resolution structural MRI is used to test how hippocampal subregions and subfields underlie the development of episodic memory in early childhood; (3) task and resting-state fMRI are combined to test the relation between hippocampal memory network and episodic memory in early childhood. Then, I will discuss the implications of these findings in terms of designing research-based interventions for children with difficulty in memory.

data.abstract: A "predictive coding" hypothesis proposes that the brain dynamically anticipates and generates predictions about upcoming stimuli to guide perception efficiently. Here, we combined functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI), multi-voxel pattern decoding, and an innovative time-resolved psychophysical paradigm to assess the temporal profile and spatial distributions of this prediction process. Strikingly, we demonstrate rhythmic population activity in several task-related brain areas. Specifically, multi-voxel activity patterns in the fusiform face area (FFA) and the parahippocampal place area (PPA) show temporal fluctuations at a theta-band (~5 Hz) rhythm that accompany effects in visual object priming. These results provide novel and essential constraints to understand the neuronal dynamics of predictive coding. Moreover, these results suggest a feasible fMRI strategy to measure temporal fluctuations of multi-voxel activity patterns in the human brain, providing a critical link between fMRI measurements and neurophysiological recordings to understand fine-scale spatiotemporal dynamics of attention and consciousness.

Using a panel of 1774 Chinese listed firms over the period 2007-2014, we examine the role played by different sources of financing in supporting R&D investment. We find that, contrary to what is typically observed in mature economies, bank loans play an important role in funding R&D investment in China . We also show that banks are more likely to direct funds towards those firms whose R&D investment is already supported by a government grant. The receipt of the grant in fact provides the bank with a signal that the firm's R&D project is valuable. This signaling effect is particularly important for non-state-owned firms, for young firms, for firms facing high demand uncertainty, and for firms operating in less financially developed provinces. As these groups of firms are all more likely to face asymmetric information problems and financing constraints, we conclude that bank lending aimed at financing firms' R&D investment in China follows market principles. data.abstract: Part 1 The credibility of scientific discovery in biomedical research has greatly damaged by high-profile scandals and poor reproducibility rate for well-known research findings. This talk will discuss several high-prolife cases and how data falsification, poor research practice and misused statistical methods execrated the problem. Recommendation on good clinical research practice will be made to improve reproducibility of biomedical research. Part 2 In the era of personalized medicine, an increasing number of cancer drugs are being developed to target specific genetic variations among patients. Biomarker-integrated randomized clinical trials (RCTs) are essential tools for evaluating drug effects of specific patient groups with different biomarker status, as well as the utility of the putative biomarker for treatment selection. data.abstract: In this talk, first I will discuss face processing in the amygdala and anterior cingulate cortex (ACC). I will show that single neurons in the human amygdala encode subjective judgment of emotions instead of physical stimulus properties. With a combination of single-neuron recordings, fMRI, and amygdala lesion patients, I will further show that the amygdala parametrically encodes both emotion intensity and ambiguity. With a combination of EEG and fMRI, I will show that a late positive potential, the LPP, differentiates levels of ambiguity, and is specifically associated with behavioral judgments of ambiguity rather than mere perception of ambiguous stimuli. People with autism have social difficulties and show altered attention to, and preferences for specific categories of visual information. In the second half of the talk, I will discuss two social attentional deficits in people with autism: (1) Using a comprehensive saliency model and eye tracking to quantify the relative contributions of each image feature to visual saliency, I will show that people with autism demonstrate atypical bottom-up spontaneous visual attention across multiple levels and categories of objects. (2) Using a goal-directed visual search task, in which target saliency varies trial-by-trial according to search instruction, I will show that people with autism have reduced attention to target-congruent search items, especially for social targets, suggesting a top-down attentional deficit. In conclusion, using multimodal cognitive neuroscience methods, I will present how different aspects of facial emotions are encoded in the amygdala and ACC, and illustrate both bottom-up and top-down attentional deficits in autism. I will also discuss the link between the amygdala function and autism.

We examine the effect of booming housing price in China on manufacturing investment using a combined firm- and city-level panel data set for the period 2003-2007. Our results show that there was a significant negative association between local housing prices and the investment ratio of manufacturing firms in the corresponding cities. The effect is robust in controlling for heterogeneities at firm, sector, and city levels, and in dealing with the potential endogeneity of housing price. The negative relationship is strongest for firms which are labor intensive, non-state owned, and have few linkages with real estate sectors.

西南财经大学经济与管理研究院副教授,博士,毕业于Oklahoma State University。主要研究领域:Agent-Based Modeling;Social Networks; IO; Experimental Economics; Public Policy;Evolutionary Economics。在Journal of Economic Interaction and Coordination, American Journal of Agricultural Economics, Computational Economics,《经济研究》等期刊发表论文多篇,并主持国家自然科学基金等多项科研项目。

早年毕业于北京医科大学(现北京大学医学部)实验医学专业,获学士学位( 1982 ), 1985 年获暨南大学医学院病理生理学专业硕士学位, 1989 年获美国新墨西哥州立大学实验心理学硕士学位, 1993 年获新墨西哥州立大学认知心理学博士学位。曾任教于暨南大学医学院病理生理学系 (1985-1987 年,讲师 ) , 1993 年至今任教于美国南达科他大学心理系, 2003 年升任正教授。 王晓田教授也是德国马克斯 · 普朗克研究所、新加坡管理大学、中欧国际商学院、香港科技大学和北京大学等的客座教授或兼职教授。现任 Frontiers in Evolutionary Psychology 副主编; Journal of Behavioral Decision Making, The PsyCh Journal 和《心理学报》等编委 , Behavior and Brain Sciences 特邀评论员 , 经济生物学杂志的专刊主编,和 40 多种专业杂志特邀审稿人;美国国家科学基金会特邀评审专家组成员,中国国家自然科学基金委管理学部海外评审专家,中国科学院心理研究所行为科学重点实验室学术委员会委员等。 研究兴趣主要涉及社会、组织、管理及跨文化领域的决策行为及决策偏差 , 风险知觉和风险管理,概率判断和推理 , 决策的理性原则 ( 进化理性 , 生态理性和社会理性 ), 风险行为和取向的测量 , 消费与选举行为 , 以及风险决策的情绪及身体机制等。有关的研究方法包括实验研究 , 调查与访谈 , 实地研究 , 量表开发 , 数学模型与计算机模拟,以及生理指标测试等。主持和参与美国国家科学基金会资助项目 , 美国麦克道尔基金会资助项目 , 美国麦克阿瑟基金会资助项目等一大批科研项目。其研究成果发表于 Behavioral and Brain Sciences, Journal of Experimental Psychology: General, Psychological Science, Cognition , Neuropsychologia, Journal of Behavioral Decision Making 等 20 余种国际重要学术期刊上,并被《 TIME 》 ( 美国《时代周刊》 ) 、《 The Wall Street Journal 》(《华尔街日报》)、《科学新闻》杂志、雅虎网站等多家知名新闻媒体进行过报道。 更多王晓田教授介绍请参见: http://www.usd.edu/arts-and-sciences/psychology/x-t-wang.cfm http://usd-apps.usd.edu/xtwanglab/index.html
